newsitem.title: USA: ANR says US Gulf cold cuts 200 mmcfd natgas.
newsitem.headline: ANR says US Gulf cold cuts 200 mmcfd natgas.

text.p: Coastal Corp unit ANR Pipeline said Monday that cold weather along the U.S. Gulf Coast forced the shut in of about 200 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas on the southeast leg of its pipeline system.

"The southeast leg is down by about 200 million (cfd). Freezing rain in the Gulf Coast area is causing equipment problems and loss of power," a company spokesman said, adding he expected flows to be back to normal "in a day or so".
The spokesman said the southeast leg was flowing about 1.2-1.3 billion cubic feet per day before the interruptions.
He said the company's southwest leg was experiencing only "minor" freeze-offs and was flowing at near normal rates of about 700 mmcfd.
